doctrine: Evoto AI is a standalone portrait retouching platform (Windows/macOS/iPadS) that replaces 80% of manual skin/face work via AI while preserving texture detail. Core value: collapses per-image retouching from 5min (Photoshop) to seconds, enabling volume profitability. Key differentiators: wrinkle removal preserves pores (not blur), freckle preservation vs blemish removal, AI Color Match analyzes reference image color relationships and maps across session with per-frame lighting adjustment. Workflow sequence: shoot -> cull -> global edit (Lightroom) -> AI retouch (Evoto) -> batch process -> spot-check 10-15% -> export. Batch editing: save retouching intensity+color as presets, apply across session in one click. Tethered via Evoto Instant (wired USB/OTG or wireless FTP) processes images real-time to phone/cloud, enabling on-location client review. Full 50-image portrait session: under 90min import-to-delivery with Evoto vs 2+ hours manual retouching. Operating principle: AI handles production bottleneck; craft lives in direction/lighting/moment. Retouching is production work, automate it.
workflows: Shoot -> cull ruthlessly -> Lightroom global edit (sync exposure/WB/tone/HSL) -> export full-res JPG/TIFF -> Evoto batch import
Single image hero edit: full retouching + color treatment -> save as preset -> batch apply to remaining images -> spot-check 10-15% edge cases
Tethered shooting workflow: camera connection (wired/FTP) -> real-time AI processing on phone -> client review on location -> immediate approval/re-shoot decisions
Multi-location shoots with lighting variance: use AI Color Match with hero edit as reference to map color relationships across session with per-frame lighting correction
tools: FTP wireless transfer or USB/OTG wired
operating_rules: Face reshaping must be subtle; if client notices, you went too far
Teeth whitening use conservatively; glowing-white teeth look fake
Clothing dewrinkle only; do not reshape client body via AI liquify
Freckle preservation calibration: remove blemishes while keeping identifiable freckles intact
Spot-check 10-15% of batch for edge cases: different lighting, subject distance, skin tones in group shots
Wrinkle removal must preserve pore-level skin texture detail, not blur
Color match works best when reference image and target images share similar lighting (per-frame adjustment handles variance)
Batch presets can be shared across team/second shooter for consistency
Tethered connection supports one camera at a time on wired; multiple cameras on wireless FTP
AI retouching is production automation, not artistic deception; craft protected in direction/lighting/moment
